method.peaks: RoWatcher /api/v1/games/<id>/history?from=2026-07-01; daily peak = 2nd-highest sample per UTC day; single-day spikes >4x both neighbours replaced; 7-day peak = max trailing 7-day median of daily peaks
method.beat_parent: child CCU now > parent CCU now, OR child 7-day peak > parent 7-day peak (press ATH used for Steal a Brainrot 25.4M and Grow a Garden 22.4M)
method.lag_after_parent_10k_d: child created date minus (parent created + parent's first day >=10K in RoWatcher; an upper bound when the parent was first tracked above 10K)
method.roles: origin = lineage root; mutation = first distinct version of a change; copy = repeats a sibling's change (same week or later) or same-title race loser
method.types: ORIGIN, VERB, REWARD, SOURCE, RISK, SETTING, INVERSION, GRAFT (adds a genre system: RNG, combat, +1, TD, tycoon, build, PvP), TOOL, SOCIAL, NOUN (noun/theme-only), FANTASY (+1 games: the avatar transformation is the noun)

suspect.9584852943: +1 Speed Keyboard Escape: RoWatcher shows 3.3-5.6M daily peaks Aug-Oct 2026, not credible; peak excluded

taxonomy.note: beat_parent inside primary_mutations counts trivial wins over dead origin games; use beat_real_hit_parent_by_type (parent peak >=10K)
